name: Bold Poster
best_for: Factual spreads alternating with emphatic statements
avoid_for: Decks that need to communicate dense information per slide — the layout is built around a few large statements, not paragraphs of detail
weak_cases: Long headlines weaken the display treatment; dense prose needs a factual spread rather than a statement frame.
visual_signature: Shrikhand display, tomato red and newsprint grids alternate dense spreads with spare statements.

provenance.adaptation: Recipe retained and curated for Deck Studio; selector describes source-supported structures, not rendered acceptance.

language_posture: Shrikhand letterforms drive the identity; another script needs a deliberate display adaptation, not assumed equivalence.

assets.images: No image required; type, shapes and surface treatments can carry the system.
